mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >55% of FEDFUNDS decline periods or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that triggers equity selling pressure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >55% of triggered instances or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction that signals broader economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline or Rank IC for interaction < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing sector slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of INDPRO < 95.0 periods or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >55% of PAYEMS growth periods or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 650,000 units signals robust housing market that drives consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >55% of HOUST > 650.0 periods or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline and CPIAUCSL above 2.5% signals inflation-driven monetary tightening that increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% or Rank IC for interaction < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales above 380,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand that supports economic growth and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >55% of RSAFS > 380.0 periods or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.
